reading.zh: 先看 states：状态名与合法转换是任务语义的单源定义；再看 safety：三级失效保护的阈值与事件级别（KILL > LAND > WARN）由主调度每帧消费。
reading.en: Start with states: state names and legal transitions are the single definition of mission semantics. Then safety: its three tiers (KILL > LAND > WARN) are consumed every frame by the dispatcher.
